subject: StrataCorp AP: PO evidence, VAT proof, and EFT remittance routing
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@stratacorp.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Michael Lowe <michael.lowe@stratacorp.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor setup + PO evidence needed for Redwood

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. AP is starting vendor registration for Redwood so we can process your invoices against POs. To get you into our system and avoid payment delays we need the following: 

- Completed AP onboarding form (attached)
- Tax proof: W-9 (US) or VAT registration certificate if doing EU invoices
- Bank remittance instructions and a sample invoice PDF matching fields we require (PO number, remit-to, invoice number, tax breakdown)
- Do you accept net-30? If not, what are your standard terms?

Also a quick note on PO routing: our system requires the PO field to be in the invoice header AND encoded in the PDF metadata. Can your billing system inject the PO number coming from our purchase order (we can deliver a CSV mapping on first run)?

Attached is the StrataCorp AP onboarding form. If you can return the completed packet and the other docs by EOD Friday we will prioritize setup.

Best,
Anika Shah
StrataCorp — Procurement / AP
attachments: StrataCorp_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Vendor setup + PO evidence needed for Redwood

Forwarding StrataCorp AP request — they want onboarding packet, W-9/VAT, sample invoice that includes PO in header and metadata, and bank remit instructions. They also asked about net-30.

Karthik — can you confirm if sales agreed to net-30 for this account (deal_8341)? If we need to propose alternative terms, please advise.

Rishi — finance will need to confirm the invoice metadata change (embed PO in PDF). Do we have a template we can generate automatically for StrataCorp? If not, we should prepare a manual sample for first invoices.

I’ll fill out the StrataCorp AP form and attach our standard W-9 and bank instructions. Please keep thread tight — we may need to loop legal if terms deviate.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112
attachments: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf, Redwood_Bank_Instructions_REDD-ACCT.docx

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor setup + PO evidence needed for Redwood

Laura / Karthik — quick responses from finance: 

- Net-30 is acceptable for StrataCorp given expected volumes, we can approve.
- We will not change billing terms for earlier invoices; initial invoices should be marked net-30 and Finance will confirm payment schedule after AP setup.
- On embedding PO into PDF metadata: we don’t currently write into PDF XMP metadata in our billing pipeline. We can provide two practical options: 
  1) Include the PO prominently in the invoice header (Invoice template already has a PO field) and supply a companion CSV mapping file on submission which AP can ingest.
  2) We can export a PDF where the PO is included as a visible header and also as a small machine-readable line (e.g., "PO:=STRATA-12345") in the footer; that will be stable for their ingestion rules.

Finance prefers option 2 for reliability on the first run; it avoids them needing to parse attachments. We can automate this for recurring invoices.

I’ll work with Billing to produce a sample invoice PDF for StrataCorp.

—Rishi
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@stratacorp.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: ap@stratacorp.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + PO evidence needed for Redwood

On Tue, Mar 22, 2027 at 9:45 AM laura.bennett@redwood.com wrote:
> Forwarding StrataCorp AP request — they want onboarding packet, W-9/VAT, sample invoice that includes PO in header and metadata, and bank remit instructions. They also asked about net-30.

Thanks Laura — that sounds good. A couple clarifications from AP: 

- VAT: We are UK-based for this buying entity; if you will invoice StrataCorp UK, we need an EU VAT registration number on your invoice (or proof of exemption). If you don’t have an EU VAT, we will need a completed "reverse charge" declaration (we can share the template).
- Bank instructions: we prefer receiving a bank-verified authorization page (bank letter or voided check is OK) rather than a Word doc. That speeds up setup.
- For the PO metadata requirement, option 2 sounds fine but AP will validate the footer tag works in our ingestion sandbox. Can you send the sample invoice and a CSV example before EOD Thursday so we can test?

Also note: StrataCorp requires UBO (ultimate beneficial owner) fields for non-US vendors. Our onboarding form has that section — if Redwood is US-based, please populate accordingly.

Regards,
Anika Shah
StrataCorp — Procurement / AP

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Anika Shah <anika.shah@stratacorp.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Mar 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + PO evidence needed for Redwood — files and samples attached

Anika — thanks for the clarifications. Attached are the completed onboarding form and the tax/bank docs you requested. Quick notes below: 

- Attachments: StrataCorp_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf (completed), Redwood_W9_2027.pdf (signed), Redwood_Bank_Verification_LETTER.pdf (bank letter), Sample_Invoice_STRATA-TEST.pdf (shows footer tag and PO in header), Sample_PO_Mapping.csv
- VAT: Redwood is US-registered; we do not have EU VAT. We have completed the reverse-charge declaration section on the onboarding form and ticked the UBO section accordingly.
- Payment terms: Redwood accepts net-30 for StrataCorp (confirmed by Finance).
- Invoice metadata: per Rishi we exported a PDF that includes visible PO in header and a footer machine tag "PO:=<PO_NUMBER>". We included a Sample_PO_Mapping.csv you can ingest for the first batch. 

If your AP sandbox flags anything, please send the error screenshots and we’ll iterate quickly. Once you confirm the DocuSign/registration link is processed we will send our first invoice referencing your PO number.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0112
attachments: StrataCorp_AP_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Redwood_W9_2027.pdf, Redwood_Bank_Verification_LETTER.pdf, Sample_Invoice_STRATA-TEST.pdf, Sample_PO_Mapping.csv
